biggest_catch: Every study has its own narrow eligibility (age, hearing, language, health criteria) and pay varies per study — you only earn if you qualify and complete a specific study.
catches: Eligibility is study-specific and narrow (e.g. 18-29 women using Instagram and Hinge; cochlear implant users; caregivers of infants; 18-65 with normal hearing)
Payment method is digital gift cards for several studies, not cash
Individual studies expire and new ones are posted — availability varies
The highest figure ($450) is spread over an 8-week study with weekly online + in-person sessions, not a quick payout
EEG/cap-with-gel sessions involve physical discomfort and time beyond the stated visit length is not compensated separately

c1.evidence: Official Northwestern (northwestern.edu) Department of Psychology page states: '$10 for their time' (20-min study), '$15/hour via digital gift card' (3-3.5 hr visits), '$20/hour' (2.5-3 hr), '$50-$100' (1-2 hr HBCD visit), 'up to $450 USD' (8-week sleep study).

c2.evidence: Amounts stated exactly per study; session lengths stated alongside. Digital gift cards at face value.

c3.evidence: Page fetched live 2026-09-23; listings dated 4/1/2026 through 9/22/26 — current and actively recruiting.

c4.evidence: No fees, no purchases; free to email researchers and join studies.

eligibility: Varies by study; 18+ generally, plus study-specific criteria (age bands, hearing/vision, language, health status, location — must travel to Northwestern's Evanston or downtown Chicago campus for in-person studies).
notes: Distinct from wave-1 Northwestern entries (Kellogg Behavioral Research R3049, NEAR Lab R3063) — this is the Department of Psychology's standing paid-research listings page.
numeric_basis: payout from official page: $10 per short study up to $450 for the 8-week sleep study; time: stated session lengths 20 min single visit to 3.5 hr visits, up to ~19 hrs active for the 8-week study.

payout_value_note: Per-study pay; gift cards at face value. $450 is the max for one 8-week study; typical single-visit studies pay $10-$70.

steps: Open the Northwestern Psychology 'Paid Research Opportunities' page and read current study listings
Pick a study whose eligibility (age, health, language, location) you meet
Contact the listed researcher by email (or complete the linked screening survey)
Pass the screening and schedule the visit at Northwestern's Evanston or Chicago campus
Complete the study session(s); receive the stated payment (digital gift card or check, per study)
timing: 20 minutes (dating-app study) to 3.5-hour visits ($15-20/hr studies); the $450 sleep study runs 8 weeks (~19 hrs active). Payment given at end of visit or over the study.
